title: Cryptographic Definitions
description: Enumerates cryptographic algorithm families, elliptic curves, and protocols with their specific metadata.

lastUpdated.title: Last Updated
lastUpdated.description: The date and time (timestamp) when the data was last updated.

algorithms.title: Algorithm Families
algorithms.description: An array of cryptographic algorithm family definitions.

items.title: Algorithm Family
items.description: Defines a cryptographic algorithm family and its metadata.

family.title: Algorithm Family
family.description: The name of the cryptographic algorithm family.

standard.title: Standards
standard.description: List of standards defining or relating to the algorithm family.

items.title: Standard Reference
items.description: Reference to a standard, including its name and URL.

name.title: Standard Name
name.description: The name or identifier of the standard.

url.title: Standard URL
url.description: A URL pointing to the standard's official documentation.

variant.title: Variants
variant.description: Defines algorithm variants by a naming pattern and the corresponding cryptographic primitive.

items.title: Standard Reference
items.description: Reference to a standard, including its name and URL.

pattern.title: Standard Name
pattern.description: Defines the pattern used to construct the complete algorithm name. Placeholders are defined by {} for algorithm-specific properties.

primitive.title: Primitive
primitive.description: Type of cryptographic primitive (e.g., signature, encryption, hash).

standard.title: Standards
standard.description: List of standards defining or relating to the algorithm variant.

items.title: Standard Reference
items.description: Reference to a standard, including its name and URL.

name.title: Standard Name
name.description: The name or identifier of the standard.

url.title: Standard URL
url.description: A URL pointing to the standard's official documentation.

ellipticCurves.title: Elliptic Curves
ellipticCurves.description: An array of elliptic curve family definitions.

items.title: Elliptic Curve Family
items.description: Defines an elliptic curve family and its metadata.

name.title: Curve Family Name
name.description: The name of the elliptic curve family.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of the elliptic curve family.

curves.title: Curves
curves.description: List of curves in this family.

items.title: Curve
items.description: Defines a specific elliptic curve and its metadata.

name.title: Curve Name
name.description: The name of the elliptic curve.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of the elliptic curve.

oid.title: OID
oid.description: The Object Identifier (OID) of the elliptic curve.

form.title: Form
form.description: The form of the elliptic curve.

aliases.title: Aliases
aliases.description: List of aliases for this curve.

protocols.title: Protocol Families
protocols.description: An array of cryptographic protocol family definitions. Each protocol family shall appear at most once, and each version at most once within its family.

items.title: Protocol Family
items.description: Defines a cryptographic protocol family and its metadata.

family.title: Protocol Family
family.description: The name of the cryptographic protocol family.

description.title: Description
description.description: A description of the protocol family.

standard.title: Standards
standard.description: List of standards defining or relating to the protocol family.

version.title: Versions
version.description: List of versions of the protocol family, each with its algorithm composition.

items.title: Protocol Version
items.description: Defines a specific protocol version and its algorithm composition.

version.title: Version
version.description: The version identifier of the protocol. Together with the protocol family, it identifies this entry: a BOM references it by exact match of protocolProperties.type and protocolProperties.version.

standard.title: Standards
standard.description: List of standards defining or relating to this protocol version.

algorithmFamiliesEnum.title: Algorithm Families
algorithmFamiliesEnum.description: An enum for the algorithm families.

protocolFamiliesEnum.title: Protocol Families
protocolFamiliesEnum.description: An enum for the protocol families.

meta:enum.x509: X.509 public key certificates, as profiled for the Internet PKI. Its composition describes signature algorithms used by the certificate format. Model an individual certificate as a certificate asset.

standardRefs.title: Standards
standardRefs.description: List of references to standards or registries.

items.title: Standard Reference
items.description: Reference to a standard or registry, including its name and URL.

name.title: Standard Name
name.description: The name or identifier of the standard.

url.title: Standard URL
url.description: A URL pointing to the standard's official documentation.

composition.title: Protocol Composition
composition.description: The functional slots of a protocol and the options for each slot. The registry describes the options a conforming implementation can support or negotiate. A BOM reports the options known for its subject. Which slots apply depends on how the protocol is used.

compositionSlot.title: Composition Slot
compositionSlot.description: A functional slot of a protocol and the options that can fill it. For example, the TLS client signature slot applies when the client authenticates with a certificate.

role.title: Composition Role
role.description: The function this slot serves in the protocol. Producers should use the registry spelling when it applies and qualify producer-defined roles with an organization namespace. A role with no matching registry slot may be reported and remains unresolved.

selection.title: Selection
selection.description: When the protocol uses this slot, all-of means that all members are used together, any-of means that one or more are used, and one-of means that exactly one is used.

selectedBy.title: Selected By
selectedBy.description: Specifies the mechanism by which the algorithms used at runtime are selected from the set: fixed by the protocol specification itself (protocol-fixed), fixed when the software is built (build-time), chosen by configuration (configuration), agreed between the parties at runtime (negotiation), or not known (unknown).

selectingParty.title: Selecting Party
selectingParty.description: The party of the protocol that makes the selection, named by its role in the protocol.

protocolIdentifier.title: Protocol Identifier
protocolIdentifier.description: The value assigned to this option by the protocol in this composition slot. If name and identifier both resolve in the same registry slot, they shall identify the same option. Preserve the spelling and case of textual identifiers. Encode numeric codepoints as unsigned decimal strings without leading zeroes, except for zero itself. The identifier may be omitted when name already contains the protocol identifier.

algorithmName.title: Algorithm Name
algorithmName.description: The concrete algorithm name. The name shall match at least one variant pattern of an algorithm family defined in this document; a name matching no variant pattern does not resolve against this registry.

algorithmSet.title: Algorithm Set
algorithmSet.description: The options for this slot. Each member is an algorithm, a protocol option or a sub-protocol.

oneOf.title: Protocol Composition Option
oneOf.description: An option selected as one unit, such as a cipher suite or hybrid group. Registry authors should supply its protocol name, assigned identifier and constituent algorithms where known. BOM producers may report only the name or identifier they observed and may link to specific assets in the BOM.

name.title: Protocol Name
name.description: The protocol-specific name of this option.

algorithms.title: Bundled Algorithms
algorithms.description: The algorithms used together by this option, when known.

oneOf.title: Sub-Protocol Reference
oneOf.description: A sub-protocol identified by family and optionally version. A BOM can also identify the specific protocol component.

ref.title: Protocol Reference
ref.description: Reference to a protocol component in this BOM. Its family and any stated version shall agree with this member.

compositionAlgorithm.title: Composition Algorithm
compositionAlgorithm.description: A registry variant name or a reference to an algorithm component in this BOM.

name.description: The registry variant name, when known. If a name and reference are both supplied, they shall describe the same algorithm and compatible parameters. The referenced component display name need not equal this name.

ref.title: Algorithm Reference
ref.description: Reference to a component with cryptoProperties.assetType="algorithm" in this BOM. Reference existence and asset type require semantic validation.

compositionAssetLinks.title: Composition Member Asset Links
compositionAssetLinks.description: References to assets associated with this composition member, such as its keys or certificates.

allOf.$comment: This is a mixin. A composition member must identify the related asset.

relatedCryptographicAsset.title: Related Cryptographic Asset
relatedCryptographicAsset.description: A cryptographic asset associated with the subject component or composition member.

type.title: Type
type.description: The kind of referenced cryptographic asset, such as an algorithm, certificate, public key, or private key.

assetRef.title: BOM Asset Reference
assetRef.description: The refId of a component in the same BOM.
assetRef.$comment: Uses the value constraints of the CycloneDX 2.0 refLinkType. The registry schema can be validated on its own.
